Sentence (English): I've had my dishwasher for a couple months now.
Comments (English): [ Best interior configuration, everything fits! ] || ---------------- || I've had my dishwasher for a couple months now. My living room, kitchen and dining room are in a U-shape and there is just a partial wall that separates the living room from the kitchen so the dishwasher I had before was quite loud, and I couldn't run it if I had company in the living room. This dishwasher is so quiet that I can't even hear it running when I'm standing next to it, I have to really listen. I love the third rack and I have noticed that my wood handled utensils come out of the third rock and they don't feel dry, cracked and abrasive like they did out of my last dishwasher. It's the same soap, the same water, but the handles come out feeling normal. I also love the fact that I can put tiny things up there that I would normally have to hand wash. Overall, it's a great dishwasher. The dishes come out clean, the crystal is sparkling and I am happy! I have to say over all KitchenAid products are by and far the highest quality, best functioning appliances that I have used in the 50 years I've been cooking.

Sentence (English): It was installed on 80cm of non-standard countertop and a small countertop was made for the remaining 20cm.
Comments (English): [ Can be installed on a 10cm mop holder ] || ---------------- || It was installed on 80cm of non-standard countertop and a small countertop was made for the remaining 20cm. The cost was as per the official table, and both the sink technician and the installer were friendly. The mop holder is 10cm, and there is a 0.5cm difference in height between the sink door and the dishwasher door, but it is not noticeable. The mop holder was cut by about 1.5cm, but it is not visible because it is viewed from the front. I tried it once as a demonstration, and the large pot was stuck, so I cleaned it by hand, and the rest, such as the rice bowl with rice cakes, were sparkling clean. I used half a pack of Frosch detergent. I think it was enough. I think it would be better to put the large pot in at an angle if possible to clean it better. The noise was low enough that it did not bother me much even at night.
Comments (Original): [ 걸레받이 10cm에도 설치가능 ] || ---------------- || 비규격장 80cm에 설치했고 남은 20cm에 작은장으로 만들어주셨습니다. 비용은 공식표대로 나왔고 싱크대기사님과 설치 기사님 모두 친절하셨습니다. 걸레받이가 10cm인데 싱크대문짝과 식세기문짝 높이가 0.5cm 단차가 있지만 눈에 거슬릴정도는 아닙니다. 걸레받이는 1.5센치정도 컷팅했지만 정면에서는 내려다 보기때문에 눈에 보이지 않습니다.시범으로 한번 돌려봤는데 큰솥 눌러붙은건 세척이 조금 덜되어서 손으로 한번해줬고 나머지는 밥풀뭍은 밥그릇 등 번쩍번쩍 매우 깨끗하게 되었습니다. 세제는 프로쉬 반토막 넣었는데.. 충분한거 같습니다. 큰솥도 가능하면 비스듬하게 넣는게 세척이 더 잘될거 같아요. 소음은 밤에해도 크게 방해되지 않을정도로 적었습니다.

First of all, I'm shocked that a normal load takes over 3 hours to complete. That doesn't seem super energy efficient to me. Secondly, my silverware doesn't dry all the way. Even when I didn't empty the dishwasher until the next morning, I still had to dry the bottoms of each piece with a towel. It's been an adjustment compared to my previous Whirlpool - silverware not on the door, door opens so low to the ground. But I'm sure I'll get used to it and it'll be a great machine,.

Sentence (English): Bosch Under bench DW fits snug.
Comments (English): [ Looks Good & is Quiet ] || ---------------- || Bosch Under bench DW fits snug. Washes well, I generally use the auto wash 2hr 30 min cycle, but have used the 1 hr & express 29 mins cycles for coffee cups, plastics and non greasy plates & utensils, these cycles clean well. Plastics are generally dry unless something has turned upside down. I like the option of the fold down prongs, the knife tray and the extra clean zone for heavily soiled dishes. The filter is easy to reach and clean. I use the DW daily, generally at night when I sit down to watch tv or before bed. It's quiet and I've only heard the end signal if I'm in the kitchen. The DW turns itself off when cycle finished, I would have preferred it to display “end” so whoever is up first knows to unpack the DW. I've had the DW for 3 weeks plus and very happy with it so far and would recommend it.

Sentence (English): Was excited to receive this new dishwasher but sadly I had to refuse it because of the installers greed.
Comments (English): [ Buyers please be advised to have your wallet ready ] || ---------------- || Was excited to receive this new dishwasher but sadly I had to refuse it because of the installers greed. wRight off the bat the installers wanted $150 dollars to install a ""Air Hammer" which stops the water pipes from banging advising me my plumbing was not up to code. Amazingly he just happened to have one in his hand! I was immediately turned off by this because it seemed that this was a common cash grab by them. it states free installation if up to code but absent their hammer I wasn't. you would think if this was a common occurrence that Costco would advise was required. The part which retails for about $20 is easily installed just by screwing it on to the water line. I asked if a permit was pulled to which the reply was no, but for another $60 we can. At this point I was totally disgusted and sent the installers and the dishwasher packing. I called my local building inspector and inquired about the water hammer and was told it was required on remodels and new construction and not on preexisting piping. I was also told that a plumbing permit was required prior to the dishwashers installation and if it wasn't a plug in unit an electrical permit was required. The installers who I assumed were licensed in Massachusetts should have known this. Obviously is not monitoring the quality of its installers because if they were this would have never happened.

One part that was not mentioned is that you will need to buy a "cable clamp" if you are hard-wiring. Fortunately I was able to take this off the old dishwasher and it fit. This part cost pennies and should have been included! Installation instructions are good except for one part. At the end it tells you to drill 7/32 pilot holes in your cabinet to attach. You can even press the start button to go between "states", not sure if this part was documented but a great feature. I was able to check that the heating element was getting hot this way. - 3rd rack only works well for items that can be sprayed from the TOP. Sentence (English): This dishwasher is installed in our secondary residence and is used sparingly.
Comments (English): [ Great until it wasn't. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is installed in our secondary residence and is used sparingly. Until recently, its performance was comparable to premium brands like Miele or Thermador. However, we have now observed that the dishes are not coming out as clean as they once did.Initially, I suspected that a dirty filter trap might be the culprit, but that did not resolve the issue. I then unplugged the unit in an attempt to reset it, but the problem persists. It now appears that there may be an electrical issue, as the top control panel and front LED indicators are not operating as they previously did. Additionally, the detergent door, though undamaged, no longer opens correctly.I am becoming increasingly reluctant to invest in GE appliances. They do not offer long-term reliability. Prior to 2010, I would not have questioned the durability of such products, but it now seems that their longevity can vary significantly.The good news is it's only $114 for the trip charge to have the appliance evaluated. At this point, I'd take a Bosch over a GE appliance.

Comments (English): [ Cleans good, drying needs improvement ] || ---------------- || I bought this from Lowes-- they had it in stock so I just bought it, put it right in my truck, took it home, pulled out the old one and put this in. I bought an extra supply hose and an extra drain hose (which I didn't need as this comes with a drain hose). One part that was not mentioned is that you will need to buy a "cable clamp" if you are hard-wiring. Fortunately I was able to take this off the old dishwasher and it fit. This part cost pennies and should have been included! Installation instructions are good except for one part. At the end it tells you to drill 7/32 pilot holes in your cabinet to attach. This should be 7/64! luckily I checked before I drilled, lol Here's my takes on this dishwasher:- Seems to clean well- Takes forever, but I like that it tells you how long its going to take on the display. Default wash is just over an hour. There is a quick wash which I've not tried yet that says about 1 hour. - Drying barely works (even if you push extra heat)- I like the *** "test-mode" and the fact that its documented in the manual. You can even press the start button to go between "states", not sure if this part was documented but a great feature. I was able to check that the heating element was getting hot this way. - 3rd rack only works well for items that can be sprayed from the TOP. I tried putting tiny diipping sauce cups up there and they won't clean. - Overall, I'm happy and think this looks nice and was good value. Worst part is the drying (or lack thereof)

Sentence (English): This is a really nice dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Nice unit ] || ---------------- || This is a really nice dishwasher. Works as expected. Operates quietly as well. However, the setup was horrendous. And so much so, I'd invite the engineers that designed the connection points to a cage match with me. I'm a design/resolution engineer and have been in manufacturing for over 35 years, it should be really embarrassing to release this product's setup to the public. Then there's the wooden “pallet”. While I think this is a really smart idea, execution is way off. The screws that fasten the unit to the wood are the same self-tapping screws used for leveling the unit. Each one of these was basically stripped due to the angular tension applied when following directions to tip on the side to remove. Likely these won't be an issue for the life-leveling of the until, but a huge miss, especially if I have to re-level it in the future. The water connection is at such an angle that no one with adult sized hands can attach the water line. Plus, with a metal inlet fitting, onto a super cheap plastic fitting, my confidence of the life cycle is realistically low. The electrical “cover” is a joke as well, not to mention the unit has to be wired to this laughable structure. As with many things, there are goods with the bads. Hopefully the set up issues I experienced are the last issues I will have with this as it really is a very nice dishwasher. It cleans all dishes really well and is WHISPER-QUIET. GE can contract me if they so wish

Comments (English): [ LG Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE6BGL1E User Review I've been looking for a dishwasher because I've been feeling like I'm wasting my time washing dishes at home lately, and I came across the latest model, LG Objet Collection DUE6BGL1. ] || ---------------- || LG Objet Collection DUE6BGL1E Dishwasher Review. These days, I feel like I'm wasting my time washing dishes at home, so I looked for a dishwasher and chose the latest model, LG Objet Collection DUE6BGL1. I've used it for a few days and summarized my thoughts! 1. 100 True Steam glass cups are sparkling! Since I wash them with steam, there are definitely less water marks left on glass cups or plates. In particular, oily pots and frying pans are washed cleanly and do not need to be soaked separately. 2. Hot air drying for immediate storage without moisture. It's good because it dries thoroughly with hot air after washing, so I can take it out and put it in the cupboard right away. It dries well, so there is less smell and it feels hygienic. 3. I didn't know that the 3-tier smart shelf storage is this convenient. Since the height of the upper shelf can be adjusted, even large pots can be easily put in. In particular, the dedicated holder where small kitchen tools such as chopsticks and scissors can be neatly stored is convenient. 4. Automatic door opening and drying. After washing, the door opens smoothly to remove the moisture inside, so the remaining moisture is definitely reduced. At first, I was surprised, but now I think I would regret not having this function. 5. DD inverter motor noise is almost non-existent. It is quiet enough to run at night. The humming sound of the old dishwasher was annoying when it was running, but this model is definitely quiet, so there is no inconvenience even in the kitchen. 6. Smartphone linkage OK even when you are out! You can connect it to the LG ThinQ app and start washing while you are out, and you can check the remaining time. It is really convenient when you are busy. Overall review: No more stress about washing dishes! . Pros: Good cleaning power, perfect drying. Almost no noise. Cons: It was a little tricky to fit the space when I first installed it. One-line summary: It is spacious and quiet, and it washes and dries well! Sentence (English): After 15+ trouble-free years, our old Bosch dishwasher's pump failed and we were advised it wasn't worth repairing.
Comments (English): [ Replaced a 15 yr old Bosch - old one was better. ] || ---------------- || After 15+ trouble-free years, our old Bosch dishwasher's pump failed and we were advised it wasn't worth repairing. That machine always got dishes spotless and dried them very well - and did everything silently! In fact that's how I knew it was finally dying - I could hear it. So of course we replaced it with a new Bosch. Unfortunately the new machine, although fairly quiet, is noisier than the old machine. The arrangement of the tines in the upper and lower racks is different and makes it difficult to get large bowls and pots to fit. And even when using the maximum drying setting, the dishes are still wet at the end of the cycle. And for the first few weeks of use, it emitted a weird burning-rubber odor as it ran, although this seems to have gone away now. As for the Home Connect app - it's nearly worthless! It often says it's "disconnected" from the dishwasher even when I'm standing right next to it. It's apparently the only way to set a delayed start on this machine ( my old machine had a simple button for this) but it DOES NOT WORK. I sure wish there was still a button on the machine for this - I shouldn't have to use my phone to start my dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ Does not dry properly ] || ---------------- || What difficult a purchase and journey! THE PURCHASE: We ordered a dishwasher on 8 Nov 2025 and it was installed by a Lowe's approved installer on 13 Dec 2025. During that time, we continuously had charges added and dropped on our credit card. Each time Lowe's re-applied the charge to our credit card, Lowe's would get a rejection. So, each time we had to call our credit card company and Lowe's to get it reapproved. This went on every 10 days. Why does Lowe's operate this way? THE INSTALLATION: The installation also had its difficulties. First, the original hole for the drain and supply hose had to be expanded. No, fault of our own. How would we have known the supply hose was larger than original. The Lowe's private installer was kind enough to make the hole larger. Then, when the installer tilted the dishwasher, he scratched our cabinet. He denied it when I pointed it out to him. Also, the Lowe's installer said the new drain hose was too short. So, he bypassed the Air Gap and connected the new drain hose directly to the garbage disposal. When questioned, he indicated that it was still within plumbing codes. After, doing some research I could not verify his claim. A few weeks later I decided to look at the connection, and guess what, I was able to connect the new drain hose to the Air Gap without much difficulty. Since the installer had cut up the original black hose that ran from the Air Gap to the garbage disposal, I had to buy a new one for about $5.00.THE REBATE: Who would have thought it would have been so difficult to receive the installation rebate, but it was. I had applied for the rebate online and provided the necessary information including the correct model number, manufacturer, and order number. I received an email indicating the model was not eligible for the rebate. I submitted proof that the model was eligible. Then, I received an email indicating the Lowes's Rebate team needed a copy of the original receipt. I'm thinking I already provided you the order number and this is Lowe's, right? I obtained the receipt from my account and emailed it to the rebate team. I was told this was not what they needed and I would have to call Lowe's Customer Service to get the Lowe's receipt. So, the Lowe's Rebate Team is telling ME to call Lowe's Customer Service to get the receipt. This Lowe's, right? Lowe's Customer Service was as confused as I was and basically sent me the same receipt I had already provided. I called the Lowe's Installation Team and again they provided me the same receipt. I submitted the two receipts and the Lowe's Rebate Team accepted them.USING THE REBATE: I received the rebate via email. I tried to use it at the local Lowe's self-checkout line and the scan code was not accepted. I was told by a customer rep I would have to go to a regular checkout line to be able use it. If I had a Lowe's Rebate Card, I would be able to use it in the self-checkout line. There are no regular checkout lines at the local Lowe's. I have to go to Customer service to use the rebate. Could this any more difficult! THE WHIRPOOL DISHWASHER: It is quieter than our old one but it does not dry properly unless you set it for Extended Dry. Very disappointed with our purchase!

I will leave an honest review after using it, so I hope it will be helpful to those who are thinking of buying it! Reason for using a 6-person one - I am currently living in a rented house! If I owned a house, I would put it in the lower cabinet as I pleased, but since renting it would be inconvenient to have to restore it when I move later, I chose a product that is placed on top of the sink. However, when I looked at the dishwasher manual, it said how much water was used per hour. It was much more water-saving than me just turning on the water and washing the dishes! It washes dishes at high temperature, so it's cleaner than when I do it! It's been about a week, and I've been doing it twice a day, in the morning and evening. Now, after dinner with my family, I don't have to do the dishes - I'm really happy because the dishwasher does it for me. I really regret why I only started using something this convenient now. I'm sure there are people who think the same way, so I wrote it down. How to use the dishwasher! - First, there are normal and strong settings. In the morning, I wash the dishes I used to make bread and coffee on the normal setting, and in the evening, I wash them on the strong setting because they're greasy. Of course, there's a separate drying button! One thing to be careful of is that you have to play Tetris well. You have to place the dishes so that the inside of the dishes is slightly facing the floor. This is because the water comes out from the bottom! Comments (English): [ Beware -- Frustrating From Day We Got It (same unit 800 series) ] || ---------------- || The first time we loaded and used this machine we were so frustrated we wanted to return it -- but seller wouldn't take it back. Several issues others have expressed, we had. The worst problem is: If you ever used a regular dishwasher, like Kitchen Aid as we did, or other regular ones for less money, you'll find loading this one is awful. The spacing is weird so you can't put nearly as many cups and glasses in the upper slider. The spacing is weird down below also, the tines are angled funny so unless all your plates and things are the exact same shape, they interfere with each other. Pans don't fit below hardly at all, and there are other impediments to loading in the lower area. The biggest joke -- watch the videos and such where they show you using the very top thin slide to lay silverware -- ha! It's clumsy, time consuming, the silverware isn't cleaned -- don't do what they suggest, folks. As soon as we win the lottery or get an inheritance, this thing is gone! Never again -- we paid like 300 more for it than a fine Kitchen Aid, only to be unhappy every day. We do like two features: (1) the drying system that isn't just a real hot burner (which we would never use anyway); and (2) it is extremely quiet. For those two reasons this machine got two stars instead of one.

After my dishes came out wet and dirty I had to research how to reset the cycle and run it again. This time the dishes came out dry and clean, although the knives still have rusty looking spots on them but they did before so I just clean them with cleanser and rewash them. I tried looking at the Bosch website troubleshooting section and apparently no one else has my problem. One other thing that I noticed is that the back wasll of the tub has water on it when I open the dishwasher the next morning to unload it. I'm still trying to investigate that as well. But all in all I like the dishwasher I just wish the directions for loaading and choosing the cycle were illustrated better. I guess if I were a 20 year old I could figure it out but for a 70 year old the directions aren't all that clear.

Sentence (English): The Bosch Dishwasher SHX78CM6N is alot different from our previous two dishwshers.
Comments (English): [ I'd give this dishwasher a rating of 4.9 stars. ] || ---------------- || The Bosch Dishwasher SHX78CM6N is alot different from our previous two dishwshers. Our first was purchased in 1972 from a different manufacturer. Dishwashers then were a little bit different, porcelain interior, door not practically on the floor. It was replaced, not with a new one, but an almost identical one about 10 years later as a gift from my brother who said the color did not match his other new apppliances. This one lasted a real long time, until Dec 2024. We were looking for one that actually dried the dished, like our old one. Many dishwashers today don't do that. I like our new dishwasher, but I am still getting used to the rack configurations, they are different from what I am used to. I like the silverware rack on top, I love the way is cleans everything, I've only had one item that didn't come clean, and that was a spoon in the top rack that had some baked beans left on, but it had turned over during the cycle. I love the crystal dry. I like how quiet it is, even though it takes three times as long as our old one. There is only one thing that I don't care for, and that is how low the door and lower rack is. Trip hazzard? All in all I am extremely happy with this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Will start off by saying that hands down, this dishwasher leaves dishes cleaner and dryer than any of the dishwashers we have owned over the past 40 years.
Comments (English): [ Almost the Real Deal ] || ---------------- || Will start off by saying that hands down, this dishwasher leaves dishes cleaner and dryer than any of the dishwashers we have owned over the past 40 years. It is replacing a very nice Kitchen Aid. The silverware tray on top is very well designed to get a large quantity of knives, forks and spoons clean and very quick to get out and put away. Same with the plate rack in the bottom. I cannot say the same for the racks for loading bowls and glasses. They do not lay in there as neatly as they should. I also didn't like having the controls hidden when the dishwasher is in use. It is mounted exactly as the directions indicate, but the lip of the countertop covers the screen. It would be nice to have it in the recessed area of the handle so you can see how much time is remaining and what cycle it is at. There is nothing to indicate the dishes are clean except the indicator light being off, so someone else coming home would not necessary know the dishes are clean. I also miss not have just a rinse cycle. It is very quiet and the looks are very appealing.

Sentence (English): There is some confusion about how the UltraFresh enable/disable LED works in Profile Dishwashers equipped with the UltraFresh feature.
Comments (English): [ UltraFresh Enable/Disable Indicator LED Confusion ] || ---------------- || There is some confusion about how the UltraFresh enable/disable LED works in Profile Dishwashers equipped with the UltraFresh feature. The user manual implies the UltraFresh LED will switch on and STAY ON even when the door is closed. This is not how the UltraFresh enable/disable LED works.Enabling UltraFreshOpen the dishwasher door and press Start to illuminate the last wash cycle and UltraFresh settings. If the UltraFresh LED is off, press the UltraFresh pad to enable UltraFresh and the LED above the UltraFresh pad will switch on. If you do not start the indicated wash cycle, the UltraFresh LED and wash cycle indicators will switch off in about 30 seconds, but UltraFresh is enabled even though the UltraFresh LED is now off. Disable UltraFreshTo disable UltraFresh, open the door and press Start to illuminate the last wash cycle and UltraFresh settings. If UltraFresh is enabled, the LED above the UltraFresh Pad will be on. Press the UltraFresh pad to disable UltraFresh and the LED above the UltraFresh pad will switch off. UltraFresh is now disabled.You can also use the Smart HQ App to enable and disable the UltraFresh feature. Me, I would have programmed the UltraFresh LED to stay on all the time when UltraFresh is enabled.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher looks beautiful, but it's not very functional for several reasons.
Comments (English): [ Beauty with No Brains ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher looks beautiful, but it's not very functional for several reasons. I had it for several months used 2x daily to weekly.There is no dry cycle. Dishes are wet when done and it causes rust to many pieces. I understand the energy saving piece, but there should be a heating/drying option regardless. Even if it was just a fan.You need a bucket for the hose when you disconnect it from the sink. No matter how much water you think you poured in the sink there always more left in the hose. You have to invert it and lower to the floor over a bucket. Z2 other portables and never had this issue.Wheels are difficult to navigate and if you have a Kitchener it will have to be moved with every use.The buttons are not intuitive at all. You will think the cycle started and when you walk back you realize it never turned on. There's no sound to let you know the beginning or end of cycle.There's organizer rack is horrible for modern plates and dishes. It only has very narrow spaces that won't fit lipped dinnerware. There's a lid on the utensil basket that always need to be removed and wastes space and is more junk to keep track of. The design does not allow for you to put the maximum amount of dinner ware.Unless you pre wash your dishes you have to use the heavy duty cycle to remove the residue and food particles on the dishes.I'm very disappointed because it's a gorgeous edition to the kitchen compared to other portables, but it's really not well designed or thought out which it should be for the premium price. I'm considering trying to sell this one to obtain another.I hope whirlpool reads this review and takes it back to the design team to rework future models.

Sentence (English): I needed a 6-person dishwasher, so I went on a wild search~~!
Comments (English): [ The clean design and colors are perfect for my taste. ] || ---------------- || I needed a 6-person dishwasher, so I went on a wild search~~! I analyzed the pros and cons of the latest models from SK Magic, Samsung, Cuckoo, and LG. After going to an offline store and seeing the actual product, I excluded SK products because they are narrow and don't fit large cooking utensils. After checking the performance and reviews of the remaining three products, I thought about it again and again, and finally bought the most expensive LG. The most decisive reason I chose LG despite its high price was that all of the other products I considered were made in China, but LG was the only one made in Korea. Of course, there were other reasons, but this was the biggest reason I chose LG. And there were two reasons I hesitated to buy it. 1) It doesn't have an automatic door opening function. 2) It's expensive compared to other products that cost 300,000 to 500,000 won. For home appliances, I always received a Happy Call or a technician in advance to coordinate the schedule, but on the day of installation, they called me in the middle of the night, so I was half asleep when I received the call. When I asked the delivery driver when it was delivered, he said that the information would be delivered on the same day due to personal information, so it would be difficult to coordinate the schedule in advance. He may call me early in the morning on the day of delivery, so I had to be careful and answer the phone. Product size The actual product feels bigger than the picture. Product design The design is simple as in the picture, and the colors are luxurious and it is so pretty, unlike an LG product. Pros The design is luxurious and pretty. It has good cleaning power. It has hot air drying and UV drying functions. Cons It doesn't hold as many dishes as I thought. The inner tray is made to be difficult to play Tetris. There is no automatic door opening function. User review The inner space is narrower than I thought, so if you put a large pot in, other dishes hardly fit. <Drying> The dishes are fine, but a little water comes out on pots or deep bowls. <Noise> It's not small, but I couldn't hear it well with the door closed, so it was okay for me personally. Precautions before purchase The sink top is made of natural marble, so an additional 100,000 won was added for installation. I was honestly surprised because it was an unexpected additional cost. If I had known before purchasing, I would have thought about it more. Since it is natural marble, it may be a little more difficult to drill holes, but the installation fee of 100,000 won seems too expensive. Some people may know about the additional cost, but I didn't know like I did (when I purchased it, there was no information about this on the details page, and since it is for 6 people, I knew there would be no separate drilling fee.) I hope that there are no people who are confused, so I am writing this. Additional) After using it for a few months, I got used to it, and the dish Tetris became easier and I got the hang of it. About 8-9 short cups or rice bowls fit in the upper compartment, and plates or large bowls fit quite a bit in the lower compartment. Since it is for 6 people, it is still hard to put in large cooking utensils. I gave up after stressing myself out trying to put them here and there, and I am washing them by hand as much as possible. I think drying progresses more if you leave the door open after washing the dishes, but I still don't know exactly about this part. In my house, the 15cm mop holder and the cabinet next to the sink cannot be repaired, so I installed it under the gas range. Since it's a rental house, I was worried about whether the dishwasher could be put in through a repairable method, but I simply removed the microwave and installed it under the gas range! When moving, you can restore it by just inserting a microwave oven, so even if you are renting, you can easily restore it to its original state if you install it under the gas range (I stored the gas range in an unused utility room). For other brands, you can contact the customer service center of the other brand to find out, and for LG induction, they said they will do it when installing the dishwasher. I could receive the installation the day after ordering, which was also great. It is cheaper than buying it at the store, and there was a card discount promotion, so I bought it at the lowest price* Oh! I was worried about the rice cooker cabinet, but they said it would be difficult to install because there is an outlet there (+). I felt this way in the beginning of the one-month review, but my quality of life has improved even more. Especially when I eat out late at night or have guests over, I don't have to worry about washing dishes. It's so nice not to have to see the dishes pile up. My husband is in charge of washing dishes, so he would pile them up and spend an hour washing them. He couldn't see them piled up, so I would do it myself, and there was some trouble, but now that I can just put them in, I don't have to worry about who's doing the dishes anymore. It's really good for those of you raising children! If you found this helpful, please click Like!

The pots and frying pans all fit in the bottom, so I can cook and there's no stress about cleaning up. It hasn't even been a month yet, but it's sooooo convenient. Check before installation. In my house, the 15cm mop holder and the cabinet next to the sink cannot be repaired, so I installed it under the gas range. Since it's a rental house, I was worried about whether the dishwasher could be put in through a repairable method, but I simply removed the microwave and installed it under the gas range! When moving, you can restore it by just inserting a microwave oven, so even if you are renting, you can easily restore it to its original state if you install it under the gas range (I stored the gas range in an unused utility room). And I also replaced the induction, but I was told that I had to raise it by 3 cm to install the dishwasher, so I raised the level (I called the Cuckoo service center and the technician visit cost was 15, the installation cost was 10, and the travel cost was 5). For other brands, you can contact the customer service center of the other brand to find out, and for LG induction, they said they will do it when installing the dishwasher. I could receive the installation the day after ordering, which was also great. It is cheaper than buying it at the store, and there was a card discount promotion, so I bought it at the lowest price* Oh! I was worried about the rice cooker cabinet, but they said it would be difficult to install because there is an outlet there (+). I felt this way in the beginning of the one-month review, but my quality of life has improved even more. Especially when I eat out late at night or have guests over, I don't have to worry about washing dishes. It's so nice not to have to see the dishes pile up. My husband is in charge of washing dishes, so he would pile them up and spend an hour washing them. He couldn't see them piled up, so I would do it myself, and there was some trouble, but now that I can just put them in, I don't have to worry about who's doing the dishes anymore. The only downside or compromise is the lower rack is pretty low, so we need to bend down to put in or retrieve things in and out of it, but that's also the reason for plenty of space too. Overall, we are very happy and satisfied with our purchase.

Sentence (English): There is some confusion about how the UltraFresh enable/disable LED works in Profile Dishwashers equipped with the UltraFresh feature.
Comments (English): [ UltraFresh Enable/Disable Indicator LED Confusion ] || ---------------- || There is some confusion about how the UltraFresh enable/disable LED works in Profile Dishwashers equipped with the UltraFresh feature. The user manual implies the UltraFresh LED will switch on and STAY ON even when the door is closed. This is not how the UltraFresh enable/disable LED works. Enabling UltraFresh. Open the dishwasher door and press Start to illuminate the last wash cycle and UltraFresh settings. If the UltraFresh LED is off, press the UltraFresh pad to enable UltraFresh and the LED above the UltraFresh pad will switch on. If you do not start the indicated wash cycle, the UltraFresh LED and wash cycle indicators will switch off in about 30 seconds, but UltraFresh is enabled even though the UltraFresh LED is now off. Disable UltraFresh. To disable UltraFresh, open the door and press Start to illuminate the last wash cycle and UltraFresh settings. If UltraFresh is enabled, the LED above the UltraFresh Pad will be on. Press the UltraFresh pad to disable UltraFresh and the LED above the UltraFresh pad will switch off. UltraFresh is now disabled. You can also use the Smart HQ App to enable and disable the UltraFresh feature. Me, I would have programmed the UltraFresh LED to stay on all the time when UltraFresh is enabled.

Sentence (English): First off, I have owned many dishwashers over several decades.
Comments (English): [ This could have been so much better ] || ---------------- || First off, I have owned many dishwashers over several decades.Second, I installed this dishwasher myself. I have had appliance installers in the past, and without exception, they all focus on speed over quality. Let's start on a positive note and work our way down.Quietness – 5 starsI have never owned a dishwasher that was this quiet when it was running. I have to hold my ear right up against it to hear anything at all.PowerControl™ Wash System – 5 starsI haven't fully experimented with the PowerControl™ wash system's several settings. Mostly, I have been using either the Auto or the Normal settings. The only difference I can detect so far is that the Normal setting takes longer to run. However, both settings clean all my dishes, utensils, and cookware very well.PrecisionWash® - 5 starsI really love the high-on-the-door placement of the soap dispenser. Coupled with the dedicated pocket on the front of the middle rack, it ensures that Bosch-recommended pods are fully dissolved during the wash cycle. But what is really great about this is that I can now place cutting boards on edge across the front of the lower rack. With past dishwashers, such placement would not allow the cycle to fully open the pod bay door, Hal, and the pod would not completely dissolve.RackMatic® Middle Rack Adjust – 5 starsI love how the middle rack can not only be raised and lowered, it can be raised and lowered unevenly so that the middle rack can be tilted. 24/7 AquaStop® Leak Protection – 5 starsI hope I never have to see the feature in action, but I'm glad to know it's there to shut off the water flow if a leak is detected.Touch Controls – 5 starsThe controls are easy to activate, and I don't have any problems with them. I like their indicator lights, too.Anti-fingerprint SS – 5 starsI never considered my Samsung's stainless steel finish to be a problem. I would polish it with canola oil every four months or so, and it never showed fingerprints. So while the benefit of the Bosch's anti-fingerprint finish is minimal, it's also nice to have.Interior Light – 5 starsI like that the interior light can be set to operate under different circumstances. I have settled on having it come on whenever the door is open. I can't say as I actually use that light; it's bright enough in my kitchen not to need it at all.Water Softener – 5 starsI have never in the past used a rinse aid, and this is the first time I've ever had a dishwasher with a water softener. I am using both features because of the hard water where I live, so I can't say which of them have eliminated water spots, but none of my dishes emerge with spots. ENERGY STAR® Certified – 5 starsThe attached tag says that it'll cost just $34 per year to operate this dishwasher. I have no way of determining the accuracy of that prediction, but I'm happy about it nonetheless.EasyGlide™ Plus Rack Glides – 4 starsThese EasyGlide™ Plus racks are the smoothest of any dishwasher I've ever owned. I'm still learning not to let go of them when I push them into the tub, because they can fly in so fast that contents can be knocked over. Tub, Full Stainless – 4 starsMy previous dishwashers have had stainless steel tubs as well, and there don't seem to be many differences. The main one is that the Bosch feels slightly smaller inside.TimeLight® – 4 starsI really like that I can see at any moment how much time is left on the cycle. I wish, however, that it would say “DONE” when a cycle had completed. If I miss the app notification or the signal beeps, I would like there to be a visual indicator.Home Connect® - 3 starsI like that the app can tell me when the dishwasher is low on salt or rinse aid, but that's where my appreciation of it ends. I dislike not being able to select certain functional options directly from the dishwasher's door panel.Flexible 3rd Rack – 3 starsThe 3rd rack is just okay. My flatware is not held sufficiently well between the triangular tines, and pieces tend to fall over. This happens particularly often since I don't regularly host dinner parties for 12 and need to wash all their flatware at the same time. That means my few pieces will sometimes get pushed over flat by the powerful water jets, rather than remaining on their edges. And because the tines are triangular, I am unable to place flatware at an angle to improve positional retention.FlexSpace® Plus Tine Flexibility – 3 starsAlthough it's nice to be able to flatten some of the tines, there were omissions in this system that should have been addressed, particularly in the middle rack. Here, the fold-down small items racks on the right are positioned on the same side as the fold-down tines. The left side of the middle rack has neither fold-down tines nor fold-down small items racks. The small items racks can easily be unclipped, but there is no horizontal mounting rod on the left. So if someone wants to use the small items racks and still fold down the tines for larger items, they're out of luck. This middle rack should be redesigned to include a horizontal mounting rod on the left so the small items racks could be switched or mixed-and-matched.Pocket Handle – 3 starsWhile I like not having a handle to smack with my hip, I never realized how I had opened previous dishwasher doors. Sometimes I would reach for the handle with an overhand grip, and sometimes I would reach for it with an underhand grip. With the pocket handle, you don't get a choice.Installation instructions – 3 starsYou would think that a dishwasher costing this much money would actually have a dedicated installation manual, but that's not the case. There were too many instances of reading, “If your model has this feature, then. ” As well, there were parts that came in separate bags that had to be opened before you could read their own “If your model has this feature, then. ” instructions.Operating manual – 3 starsWhile I understand that we live in a digital world, that doesn't mean we all grew up in a digital world. There is no printed operating manual included with this dishwasher. I downloaded the operating manual and printed it out for my own reference.Additionally, the layout of the operating manual is poor. There are no 'best practices' suggestions, and many important caveats - such as, “run an empty load upon initial installation” – are haphazardly scattered in places where they could be easily be missed.CrystalDry™ Dry System – 2 starsThe only reason this feature didn't get just 1 star is that it actually does dry the dishes very well. But that is the end of its attractiveness. Once the cycle has completed, the door does not open. That means the entire tub, all the racks, and the door remain sopping wet. Not only do the wet racks splash water onto the floor – even hours after the cycle has completed – they also splash water on the dry dishes.With my past dishwashers – and with some other Bosch dishwashers - the door would partially open to facilitate air flow to promote drying. In addition, a drying option could be set so the dishes were heated dry before the door would open. Although drying of the dishes themselves took longer with this method, there was no risk of them being rewetted by the water that remained on the racks and in the tub.Every time I empty a dishwasher, I immediately place soap or a Bosch-recommended pod in the dispenser and close its door. This tells me that the new dishes I'm putting into the dishwasher are dirty, because a cycle had not yet run to release the soap or the pod. Now I have to manually dry the soap dispenser before refilling it. and I have to dry the racks and floor as well as I unload the dishwasher.Finally, the lack of a door positioning detent makes manually turning on the dishwasher difficult to do. I have to hold the door with one hand to keep it from closing while I use the other hand to press the buttons. It is a major mistake for Bosch to have offered either their AutoAir® system or their PureDry®/CrystalDry® systems, but not both together.Bottom LineWhile I like the ideas of the interior light and the water softener, I would forego them in a heartbeat and go for a dishwasher that let the door open automatically at the end of a cycle.Average feature rating – 4.1 starsDisappointment rating – 2.5 stars

With past dishwashers, such placement would not allow the cycle to fully open the pod bay door, Hal, and the pod would not completely dissolve.RackMatic® Middle Rack Adjust – 5 starsI love how the middle rack can not only be raised and lowered, it can be raised and lowered unevenly so that the middle rack can be tilted. 24/7 AquaStop® Leak Protection – 5 starsI hope I never have to see the feature in action, but I’m glad to know it’s there to shut off the water flow if a leak is detected.Touch Controls – 5 starsThe controls are easy to activate, and I don’t have any problems with them. I like their indicator lights, too.Anti-fingerprint SS – 5 starsI never considered my Samsung’s stainless steel finish to be a problem. I would polish it with canola oil every four months or so, and it never showed fingerprints. So while the benefit of the Bosch’s anti-fingerprint finish is minimal, it’s also nice to have.Interior Light – 5 starsI like that the interior light can be set to operate under different circumstances. I have settled on having it come on whenever the door is open. I can’t say as I actually use that light; it’s bright enough in my kitchen not to need it at all.Water Softener – 5 starsI have never in the past used a rinse aid, and this is the first time I’ve ever had a dishwasher with a water softener. I am using both features because of the hard water where I live, so I can’t say which of them have eliminated water spots, but none of my dishes emerge with spots. ENERGY STAR® Certified – 5 starsThe attached tag says that it’ll cost just $34 per year to operate this dishwasher. I have no way of determining the accuracy of that prediction, but I’m happy about it nonetheless.EasyGlide™ Plus Rack Glides – 4 starsThese EasyGlide™ Plus racks are the smoothest of any dishwasher I’ve ever owned. I’m still learning not to let go of them when I push them into the tub, because they can fly in so fast that contents can be knocked over. Tub, Full Stainless – 4 starsMy previous dishwashers have had stainless steel tubs as well, and there don’t seem to be many differences. The main one is that the Bosch feels slightly smaller inside.TimeLight® – 4 starsI really like that I can see at any moment how much time is left on the cycle. I wish, however, that it would say “DONE” when a cycle had completed. If I miss the app notification or the signal beeps, I would like there to be a visual indicator.Home Connect® - 3 starsI like that the app can tell me when the dishwasher is low on salt or rinse aid, but that’s where my appreciation of it ends. I dislike not being able to select certain functional options directly from the dishwasher’s door panel.Flexible 3rd Rack – 3 starsThe 3rd rack is just okay. My flatware is not held sufficiently well between the triangular tines, and pieces tend to fall over. This happens particularly often since I don’t regularly host dinner parties for 12 and need to wash all their flatware at the same time. That means my few pieces will sometimes get pushed over flat by the powerful water jets, rather than remaining on their edges. And because the tines are triangular, I am unable to place flatware at an angle to improve positional retention.FlexSpace® Plus Tine Flexibility – 3 starsAlthough it’s nice to be able to flatten some of the tines, there were omissions in this system that should have been addressed, particularly in the middle rack. Here, the fold-down small items racks on the right are positioned on the same side as the fold-down tines. The left side of the middle rack has neither fold-down tines nor fold-down small items racks. The small items racks can easily be unclipped, but there is no horizontal mounting rod on the left. So if someone wants to use the small items racks and still fold down the tines for larger items, they’re out of luck. This middle rack should be redesigned to include a horizontal mounting rod on the left so the small items racks could be switched or mixed-and-matched.Pocket Handle – 3 starsWhile I like not having a handle to smack with my hip, I never realized how I had opened previous dishwasher doors. Sometimes I would reach for the handle with an overhand grip, and sometimes I would reach for it with an underhand grip. With the pocket handle, you don’t get a choice.Installation instructions – 3 starsYou would think that a dishwasher costing this much money would actually have a dedicated installation manual, but that’s not the case. There were too many instances of reading, “If your model has this feature, then...” As well, there were parts that came in separate bags that had to be opened before you could read their own “If your model has this feature, then...” instructions.Operating manual – 3 starsWhile I understand that we live in a digital world, that doesn't mean we all grew up in a digital world. There is no printed operating manual included with this dishwasher. I downloaded the operating manual and printed it out for my own reference.Additionally, the layout of the operating manual is poor. There are no ‘best practices’ suggestions, and many important caveats - such as, “run an empty load upon initial installation” – are haphazardly scattered in places where they could be easily be missed.CrystalDry™ Dry System – 2 starsThe only reason this feature didn’t get just 1 star is that it actually does dry the dishes very well. But that is the end of its attractiveness. Once the cycle has completed, the door does not open. That means the entire tub, all the racks, and the door remain sopping wet. Not only do the wet racks splash water onto the floor – even hours after the cycle has completed – they also splash water on the dry dishes.With my past dishwashers – and with some other Bosch dishwashers - the door would partially open to facilitate air flow to promote drying. In addition, a drying option could be set so the dishes were heated dry before the door would open. Although drying of the dishes themselves took longer with this method, there was no risk of them being rewetted by the water that remained on the racks and in the tub.Every time I empty a dishwasher, I immediately place soap or a Bosch-recommended pod in the dispenser and close its door. This tells me that the new dishes I’m putting into the dishwasher are dirty, because a cycle had not yet run to release the soap or the pod. Now I have to manually dry the soap dispenser before refilling it...and I have to dry the racks and floor as well as I unload the dishwasher.Finally, the lack of a door positioning detent makes manually turning on the dishwasher difficult to do. I have to hold the door with one hand to keep it from closing while I use the other hand to press the buttons. It is a major mistake for Bosch to have offered either their AutoAir® system or their PureDry®/CrystalDry® systems, but not both together.Bottom LineWhile I like the ideas of the interior light and the water softener, I would forego them in a heartbeat and go for a dishwasher that let the door open automatically at the end of a cycle.Average feature rating – 4.1 starsDisappointment rating – 2.5 stars

Sentence (English): I really dislike this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I really dislike this dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I really dislike this dishwasher. I have posted this review in other places because I am fed up with this dishwasher as it broke another glass tonight. It washes fine but nothing special. But it has a few major design flaws. The main one is the adjustable height of middle rack. It only has 2 levels of position & if in upper position, it is too short for wine glasses. we can get 1 in front corner & have broken a few. Sentence (English): I actually have only used this dishwasher once, but Costco's third-party installation is so deeply flawed that I've had the dishwasher for two weeks and the only thing I've gotten out of it so far is a flooded cabinet.
Comments (English): [ Third Party Installation should be a deal breaker ] || ---------------- || I actually have only used this dishwasher once, but Costco's third-party installation is so deeply flawed that I've had the dishwasher for two weeks and the only thing I've gotten out of it so far is a flooded cabinet. I ordered this dishwasher through Costco and their third-party installer was scheduled to install it. They called me the day of the scheduled installation at about 10am to let me know they just weren't going to make it that day. We couldn't reschedule until about 10 days later. On the day they finally installed my dishwasher, the team did a perfectly find job. Or so I thought. They came back three hours later because they had installed someone else's dishwasher in my kitchen and needed to swap them out. Two days later, I discovered that in the process, they had done something to my dishwasher water line and it had been leaking for two days and flooded my cabinet. I filed a claim through Costco, and they referred me back to the third-party installer. The third-party installer sent the same installation crew to my house, who insisted that there was not a leak (because the water line was turned off) and insisted no damage had been done to my cabinet. I've repeatedly asked Costco for help with this matter, and their only recourse is to keep referring me back to the third-party installer. Here I am, two weeks later, without a working dishwasher, with a leaky waterline and about $1600 of damage to my cabinets. Meanwhile, the third-party installer has stopped answering my calls and will not respond to my claim. So, until Costco gets more involved in this process, the third party installation should be a non-starter

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is very good, but it was sent without the bottom rack and Bosch will not provide a timeline for sending a new one.
Comments (English): The dishwasher is very good, but it was sent without the bottom rack and Bosch will not provide a timeline for sending a new one. I was able to install it myself although the additional junction box (sold separately) was required since I had to hardwire it. This went fine except that the power cord on the junction box should be a little longer. I had to blindly connect it to the back of the DW because it was not long enough to attach with the DW outside of the alcove. The HD delivery guys were nice and put the DW right where I asked and took the old one with no problems. HD customer service was great when I asked about the missing bottom rack. They called Bosch for me and stayed on hold without me until they connected. They sent me an order number right away so I could reconnect with Bosch later and follow my request. Score for HD service, minus one for Bosch service. It has been over two months without the bottom rack and no message from Bosch. The DW runs without it but only has about half the capacity. In hindsight I probably should not have installed it and just returned it for a different brand, but our previous Bosch DW was great.

Sentence (English): I'm a big fan of Bosch dishwashers.
Comments (English): I'm a big fan of Bosch dishwashers. My previous two lasted about 10 years each. This new one cleans well but loses a star for several things I consider flaws. One is the lack of a rinse-only cycle. And although the info out there leads you to believe you can create any cycle you want using the app, in fact the app asks you two (silly) questions and creates your "favorite cycle" for you. Rinse is not an option. Also the app help with that issue is useless. I also don't care for the lower tine arrangements. The section with folding tines won't let my dinner plates stand up. They fall all over each other. The second row of tines from the back used to fold down but doesn't now. The light on the floor is fine, but it is either on or off and always red. I just recently got rid of the red mat in front of the sink which I think would have made the light useless. You can't tell where you are in the cycle by looking at the light, even if it is drying. There is no handle or extra padding of any kind on the bottom rack. You have to pull the often very heavy rack out by grabbing a single slender bar which puts too much force on your fingers. What I thought was a step up in machines is a one-star step down.

And although the info out there leads you to believe you can create any cycle you want using the app, in fact the app asks you two (silly) questions and creates your 'favorite cycle' for you. Rinse is not an option. Also the app help with that issue is useless. I also don't care for the lower tine arrangements. The section with folding tines won't let my dinner plates stand up. They fall all over each other. The second row of tines from the back used to fold down but doesn't now. The light on the floor is fine, but it is either on or off and always red. I just recently got rid of the red mat in front of the sink which I think would have made the light useless. You can't tell where you are in the cycle by looking at the light, even if it is drying. There is no handle or extra padding of any kind on the bottom rack. You have to pull the often very heavy rack out by grabbing a single slender bar which puts too much force on your fingers. What I thought was a step up in machines is a one-star step down.

Comments (English): [ Great product purchased at a reasonable price! ] || ---------------- || High quality appliance with great features. Sleek design and appearance. Extremely quiet! I'm looking forward to the energy (money) savings as well. And my wife LOVES her new dishwasher! :)I installed this new dishwasher in our old house. There was an installation video that the included paper manual pointed me to which was helpful as well.The only issue I had with the entire process and the appliance as a whole, occurred near the end of the installation process. (This issue was not worth a review downgrade to 4 stars for me, though, overall). This model comes with a drip pan and float assembly which needs to be removed from the unit in order to install the electrical, water, and drain line. The float assembly has a small plastic connector that an orange wire harness plugs into. These wires connect the float assembly to the dishwasher's electronics system. The entire dishwasher will NOT run unless the drip pan and float assembly are connected back properly into this connector. The tech in the installation video states to "just push on the tab, and pull the connector out." That was easy enough to do at first, as the connector was very accessible because the unit was outside of the cabinet dishwasher cavity and on its back. I did notice at that time that the connector seemed overly fragile, and the very small tab you had to depress to get it out looked weak and easily breakable.Fast-forward to the end of the installation process, when I had the dishwasher completely installed. I test-ran the dishwasher and checked the installation for leaks once more before I put the toe panel back on. Unfortunately, I did find a small leak at the supply line connector to the dishwasher. Now I had to take the drip pan back out and disconnect the fragile connector with the unit fully installed, as I wasn't about to take it all back out just for that - and I shouldn't have to anyway! Long story short: The little tab broke easily when I removed the connector, and when I attempted to reattach the connector, of course it wouldn't stay in properly. There was nothing I could do to fix it. So I found a replacement part on Amazon for $20+, and my wife had to wait a whole extra week for no good reason before she could use her new dishwasher - all because of this stupid little part. So my one complaint/request to the manufacturer is: PLEASE make this part MUCH more robust, or at least improve the design in that area, so that it can be accessed and removed much more easily once the unit is fully installed, as it is not unreasonable to think that this allowing any future work/access that may be needed on the unit.

Sentence (English): Needed to purchase a replacement after our previous machine broke within a year (different brand - leaked, incredibly loud, stopped cleaning the dishes).
Comments (English): [ 2 people Dishwasher - not for a family. ] || ---------------- || Needed to purchase a replacement after our previous machine broke within a year (different brand - leaked, incredibly loud, stopped cleaning the dishes). Our requirements were not the brand we were replacing, had to be as quiet as possible due to the location, stainless steal look to match our other appliances, 3 racks for efficiency, and from Costco to ensure if it broke within a year it was under a decent warranty. This machine met those requirements. My only concern is the tine spacing of the racks. It works decently, quiet enough as long as placement of dishes works, and cleans generally well as long as your dish placement works. The tone spacing is too close but only just by a little. This forces us to limit what we put in each cycle. Plates don't fit, lids get stuck and it takes significant force to get them out, cups / mugs don't fit well on the top rack, etc. the tine spacing doesn't work well but there are only 2 of us which allows this to work well enough for us at the moment. Any family looking into a new dishwasher, do not get this. The amount of dishes you would have would not work for 1 load and would result in over packing what this dishwasher can clean leaving residue on your dishes at the start. Of course if consistent over packing occurs, the machine will prematurely fail on the other features (become loud, leak, etc). Last note- the deliver process from Costcos 3rd party was a nightmare to schedule. Costcos customer service was beyond amazing however the company they contracted for the removal was absolutely terribly in scheduling. Had a delivery day, took off of work to be available, never received a call for our delivery window from said company, had to work with Costco customer service to figure out what was happening only for the 3rd party company to tell Costco I requested to push our delivery to Saturday (this was after numerous calls to that 3rd party office and being hung up on multiple times). Costco was able to move the delivery a day sooner as, just when all appliances break, this was happening just before a holiday. Once we got past the schedule problems, and being able to ensure an easy removal of the old machine by us (had it already unplugged, clean working space around, and clear path out) the installation happened in less than 30 min. Their installation team was fast clean and efficient. Only issue was with the office scheduling.

Sentence (English): Since I make baby food, it was hard to wash the dishes after work every day.
Comments (English): [ It's pretty and practical! ] || ---------------- || Since I make baby food, it was hard to wash the dishes after work every day. Since I wash the dishes thoroughly, I think the water cost for hot water is high, and I was worried about the electricity bill for the 12-person one, so I installed an 8-person one! I was thinking of buying a used one, but when I considered the installation cost for the furniture reform, it wouldn't be much different from a new one. When I saw dishwashers installed at the houses of my acquaintances, they said that unless you cook a lot, an 8-person one would be okay for everyday use. They said that all the dishes piled up in the dishwashing tub could fit except for large pots and frying pans. So I bought an 8-person one without hesitation! By the way, LG doesn't have an 8-person furniture cabinet. The furniture reformation was very fast, from the furniture reformation to the dishwasher delivery! Coupang really seems to be the best. The furniture reformation cost was 90,000 won, and it took about 1 hour and 30 minutes. The dishwasher installer came the next day and installed it. The installation was a breeze. The installation took 20 minutes? It seems to have taken a while. I tried to buy an 8-person dishwasher at the Samsung Digital Plaza store, but they said they don't sell 8-person ones offline. It's a genuine Samsung 8-person dishwasher and it's managed by Samsung, but since there's low demand for the Samsung main line(?), it seems like they make it in another Samsung factory and sell it online. You can receive the same genuine service from Samsung. The dishwasher is intuitive, and it took 1 minute and 28 seconds when in standard mode + drying mode. Also, this dishwasher doesn't work with smart things. Since I don't use the dishwasher with a mobile app anyway, I don't really need it, but I think it's because it's cost-effective. It's good because it has a spoon holder, so it's good to put in a lot of things, and you can put small pots and frying pans in it. After installing the dishwasher, I didn't have much use for the dish dryer under the sink. I changed it to a foldable drying mat, and since I can't see the dishes that were piled up in the dish dryer under the sink, it's refreshing and clean! I should've bought it sooner. Highly recommended!

Comments (English): [ It fits compactly in tight spaces and performs well! ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I don't want to waste time washing dishes after work, but I couldn't find a suitable dishwasher because my sink is small. I happened to see it in an offline store and thought I could put it in my house if I did it right, so I bought it. Advantages 1. It's a small but still large dishwasher that can be placed in a house with a small sink. 2. At first, I wanted to buy a dishwasher with a door that opens wide downwards neatly, but it couldn't be placed because it bumped into the sink faucet. However, this product opens up and down, so the door can be opened wide even in a place with a small sink space. 3. You can freely put in and take out the two-tier tray. When putting in large dishes such as frying pans or pots, you can remove the two-tier tray and use only the first tier. It's okay to put cups, rice bowls, spoons, etc. in the two-tier tray and turn it. 4. I was worried because there was no automatic door opening function, but after the hot air dries, the steam escapes from the top, and it dries thoroughly. Many people may be concerned about this part, but if you leave it overnight and open it in the morning, the dishes will be completely dry, so you don't have to worry. It depends on the detergent you use, but if you use an all-in-one detergent (including rinse), there will be almost no stains on the glass cup. (There may be a little water stains depending on the bowl, but it seems okay overall.) 5. It is 45cm deep, but the bottom hoof is a little further inside, so if you secure about 42~43cm of space, you can install it. I was still a little short on space, so I installed it by matching the sink extension. 6. It has a hot air drying function, so the dishes come out warm and sterilized, which feels good. 7. It uses much less water than doing it by hand, and the dishes are washed much more cleanly. Disadvantages 1. It's both an advantage and a disadvantage, but it's bigger than you think. At first, I regretted it a little because the kitchen seemed too stuffy, but I got used to it, and since the amount of work to wash dishes is reduced by about 80%, I actually feel a lot of functional satisfaction, so I don't think this is a problem. 2. It's a little noisy, but it feels like white noise. 3. I only use the basic course, but the operating time is longer than I thought, so the machine keeps running until I go to bed after dinner. Since it runs longer than I thought, I sometimes hesitate whether to run it or not when there aren't many dishes. I think this is common for all dishwashers. There is one that runs on a short course, but I haven't used it yet. 4. It's a little difficult to insert thick plates. Thin plates or bowls like Corelle are definitely more suitable for use. Overall review: You should definitely buy a dishwasher. I happened to see it in an offline store and thought I could put it in my house if I did it right, so I bought it. Advantages 1. It's a small but still large dishwasher that can be placed in a house with a small sink. 2. At first, I wanted to buy a dishwasher with a door that opens wide downwards neatly, but it couldn't be placed because it bumped into the sink faucet. However, this product opens up and down, so the door can be opened wide even in a place with a small sink space. 3. You can freely put in and take out the two-tier tray. When putting in large dishes such as frying pans or pots, you can remove the two-tier tray and use only the first tier. It's okay to put cups, rice bowls, spoons, etc. in the two-tier tray and turn it. 4. I was worried because there was no automatic door opening function, but after the hot air dries, the steam escapes from the top, and it dries thoroughly. Many people may be concerned about this part, but if you leave it overnight and open it in the morning, the dishes will be completely dry, so you don't have to worry. It depends on the detergent you use, but if you use an all-in-one detergent (including rinse), there will be almost no stains on the glass cup. (There may be a little water stains depending on the bowl, but it seems okay overall.) 5. It is 45cm deep, but the bottom hoof is a little further inside, so if you secure about 42~43cm of space, you can install it. I was still a little short on space, so I installed it by matching the sink extension. 6. It has a hot air drying function, so the dishes come out warm and sterilized, which feels good. 7. It uses much less water than doing it by hand, and the dishes are washed much more cleanly. Disadvantages 1. It's both an advantage and a disadvantage, but it's bigger than you think. At first, I regretted it a little because the kitchen seemed too stuffy, but I got used to it, and since the amount of work to wash dishes is reduced by about 80%, I actually feel a lot of functional satisfaction, so I don't think this is a problem. 2. It's a little noisy, but it feels like white noise. 3. I only use the basic course, but the operating time is longer than I thought, so the machine keeps running until I go to bed after dinner. Since it runs longer than I thought, I sometimes hesitate whether to run it or not when there aren't many dishes. I think this is common for all dishwashers. There is one that runs on a short course, but I haven't used it yet. 4. It's a little difficult to insert thick plates. Thin plates or bowls like Corelle are definitely more suitable for use. Overall review: You should definitely buy a dishwasher. I kept giving up because I didn't have the courage to do construction on my rented/lease house, but the quality of my life has definitely improved with just the countertop!
Comments (Original): [ 좁은 공간에 컴팩트하게 잘 맞고 성능이 좋아요! ] || ---------------- || ■ 구매동기: 퇴근하고 설겆이 하느라 보내는 시간이 아까운데, 싱크대가 좁아서 그동안 적당한 식기세척기를 발견하지 못했어요. 우연히 오프라인 매장에서 보고나서 잘 하면 집에 놓을 수 있겠다 싶어서 구매하게 되었어요. ■ 장점 1. 싱크대가 좁은 집에 놓을 수 있는 작지만, 그래도 큰 식기세척기에요.  2. 처음에는 깔끔하게 문이 아래로 활짝 열리는 식기세척기를 사고 싶었는데, 싱크대 수전과 부딪혀서 놓을 수 없더라고요. 근데 이 제품은 위 아래 양문형으로 열려서 싱크대 공간이 좁은 곳에서도 문을 활짝 열 수 있어요.  3. 2단 트레이를 자유롭게 넣었다 뺐다 할 수 있어요. 후라이팬이나 냄비처럼 큰 식기를 넣을 때는 2단 트레이를 빼고 1단만으로 이용 가능해요. 2단 트레이에 컵이나 밥그릇, 수저 등 넣고 돌리는 것도 괜찮아요.  4. 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 고민했는데, 열풍 건조 되고 나서 상단에 김이 빠지는 곳 만으로도 충분하게 바짝 건조가 되더라고요. 이 부분은 고민하는 분들이 많으실텐데, 밤새 돌려두고 아침에 열어보면 그릇에 물기 없이 다 말라 있으니까 걱정 안 하셔도 될 것 같아요. 사용하는 세제에 따라 다르겠지만, 올인원(린스 포함) 세제를 이용하면 유리컵에도 얼룩이 거의 안 남아요. (그릇에 따라 조금씩 물때가 남는 경우는 있지만 대체로는 괜찮은 것 같아요)  5. 깊이가 45cm인데, 하단 발굽이 조금 더 안쪽에 있어서 42~43cm 정도의 공간이 확보되면 설치가 가능해요. 저는 그래도 조금 공간이 부족해서 싱크대 연장판 맞춰서 설치했어요. 6. 열풍 건조 기능이 있어서 그릇이 따끈따끈하게 소독되어 나오고 기분이 좋습니다.  7. 사람이 손으로 하는 것보다 물도 훨씬 적게 쓰고 그릇이 훨씬 깨끗하게 잘 세척이 돼요. ■ 단점  1. 장점이자 단점인데, 생각보다 큽니다. 처음에는 주방이 너무 답답해보여서 살짝 후회했는데, 익숙해지기도 하고, 설겆이 노동량이 80% 정도 줄어드니까 사실 기능적인 만족감이 커서 이 부분은 문제는 아니라고 생각해요.  2. 소음이 조금 있긴 하지만, 백색소음 같은 느낌이긴 해요. 3. 기본 코스로만 돌리는데 생각보다 가동시간이 길어서 저녁 먹고 돌리면 잠들기 전까지 계속 기계가 돌아가요. 생각보다 길게 돌아가다보니 그릇이 몇개 없을 때는 돌릴까 말까 고민이 드네요. 이건 모든 식기세척기 공통 상항일 듯 합니다. 짧은 코스로 돌리는 것도 있는데 아직 사용은 안 해봤어요.  4. 두께가 있는 접시는 꽂아 넣기가 조금 어려워요. 코렐 같은 얇은 접시나 그릇이 확실히 사용하기에 더 적합하긴 해요. ■ 총평  식기세척기 꼭 사세요. 월세집/전세집 공사까지 할 엄두가 안 나서 계속 단념하고 살았는데, 카운터탑만으로도 전보다 삶의 질이 확연히 높아지네요!

I happened to see it in an offline store and thought I could put it in my house if I did it right, so I bought it. Advantages 1. It's a small but still large dishwasher that can be placed in a house with a small sink. 2. At first, I wanted to buy a dishwasher with a door that opens wide downwards neatly, but it couldn't be placed because it bumped into the sink faucet. However, this product opens up and down, so the door can be opened wide even in a place with a small sink space. 3. You can freely put in and take out the two-tier tray. When putting in large dishes such as frying pans or pots, you can remove the two-tier tray and use only the first tier. It's okay to put cups, rice bowls, spoons, etc. in the two-tier tray and turn it. 4. I was worried because there was no automatic door opening function, but after the hot air dries, the steam escapes from the top, and it dries thoroughly. Many people may be concerned about this part, but if you leave it overnight and open it in the morning, the dishes will be completely dry, so you don't have to worry. It depends on the detergent you use, but if you use an all-in-one detergent (including rinse), there will be almost no stains on the glass cup. (There may be a little water stains depending on the bowl, but it seems okay overall.) 5. Comments (English): [ It fits compactly in tight spaces and performs well! ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I don't want to waste time washing dishes after work, but I couldn't find a suitable dishwasher because my sink is small. I happened to see it in an offline store and thought I could put it in my house if I did it right, so I bought it. Advantages 1. It's a small but still large dishwasher that can be placed in a house with a small sink. 2. At first, I wanted to buy a dishwasher with a door that opens wide downwards neatly, but it couldn't be placed because it bumped into the sink faucet. However, this product opens up and down, so the door can be opened wide even in a place with a small sink space. 3. You can freely put in and take out the two-tier tray. When putting in large dishes such as frying pans or pots, you can remove the two-tier tray and use only the first tier. It's okay to put cups, rice bowls, spoons, etc. in the two-tier tray and turn it. 4. I was worried because there was no automatic door opening function, but after the hot air dries, the steam escapes from the top, and it dries thoroughly. Many people may be concerned about this part, but if you leave it overnight and open it in the morning, the dishes will be completely dry, so you don't have to worry. It depends on the detergent you use, but if you use an all-in-one detergent (including rinse), there will be almost no stains on the glass cup. (There may be a little water stains depending on the bowl, but it seems okay overall.) 5. It is 45cm deep, but the bottom hoof is a little further inside, so if you secure about 42~43cm of space, you can install it. I was still a little short on space, so I installed it by matching the sink extension. 6. It has a hot air drying function, so the dishes come out warm and sterilized, which feels good. 7. It uses much less water than doing it by hand, and the dishes are washed much more cleanly. Disadvantages 1. It's both an advantage and a disadvantage, but it's bigger than you think. At first, I regretted it a little because the kitchen seemed too stuffy, but I got used to it, and since the amount of work to wash dishes is reduced by about 80%, I actually feel a lot of functional satisfaction, so I don't think this is a problem. 2. It's a little noisy, but it feels like white noise. 3. I only use the basic course, but the operating time is longer than I thought, so the machine keeps running until I go to bed after dinner. There is one that runs on a short course, but I haven't used it yet. 4. It's a little difficult to insert thick plates. Thin plates or bowls like Corelle are definitely more suitable for use. Overall review: You should definitely buy a dishwasher. I kept giving up because I didn't have the courage to do construction on my rented/lease house, but the quality of my life has definitely improved with just the countertop!
