I happened to see it in an offline store and thought I could put it in my house if I did it right, so I bought it. Advantages 1. It's a small but still large dishwasher that can be placed in a house with a small sink. 2. At first, I wanted to buy a dishwasher with a door that opens wide downwards neatly, but it couldn't be placed because it bumped into the sink faucet. However, this product opens up and down, so the door can be opened wide even in a place with a small sink space. 3. You can freely put in and take out the two-tier tray. When putting in large dishes such as frying pans or pots, you can remove the two-tier tray and use only the first tier. It's okay to put cups, rice bowls, spoons, etc. in the two-tier tray and turn it. 4. I was worried because there was no automatic door opening function, but after the hot air dries, the steam escapes from the top, and it dries thoroughly. Many people may be concerned about this part, but if you leave it overnight and open it in the morning, the dishes will be completely dry, so you don't have to worry. It depends on the detergent you use, but if you use an all-in-one detergent (including rinse), there will be almost no stains on the glass cup. (There may be a little water stains depending on the bowl, but it seems okay overall.) 5. It is 45cm deep, but the bottom hoof is a little further inside, so if you secure about 42~43cm of space, you can install it. I was still a little short on space, so I installed it by matching the sink extension. 6. It has a hot air drying function, so the dishes come out warm and sterilized, which feels good. 7. It uses much less water than doing it by hand, and the dishes are washed much more cleanly. Disadvantages 1. It's both an advantage and a disadvantage, but it's bigger than you think. At first, I regretted it a little because the kitchen seemed too stuffy, but I got used to it, and since the amount of work to wash dishes is reduced by about 80%, I actually feel a lot of functional satisfaction, so I don't think this is a problem. 2. It's a little noisy, but it feels like white noise. 3. I only use the basic course, but the operating time is longer than I thought, so the machine keeps running until I go to bed after dinner. Since it runs longer than I thought, I sometimes hesitate whether to run it or not when there aren't many dishes. I think this is common for all dishwashers. There is one that runs on a short course, but I haven't used it yet. 4. It's a little difficult to insert thick plates. Thin plates or bowls like Corelle are definitely more suitable for use. Overall review: You should definitely buy a dishwasher. I kept giving up because I didn't have the courage to do construction on my rented/lease house, but the quality of my life has definitely improved with just the countertop!
Comments (Original): [ 좁은 공간에 컴팩트하게 잘 맞고 성능이 좋아요! ] || ---------------- || ■ 구매동기: 퇴근하고 설겆이 하느라 보내는 시간이 아까운데, 싱크대가 좁아서 그동안 적당한 식기세척기를 발견하지 못했어요. 우연히 오프라인 매장에서 보고나서 잘 하면 집에 놓을 수 있겠다 싶어서 구매하게 되었어요. ■ 장점 1. 싱크대가 좁은 집에 놓을 수 있는 작지만, 그래도 큰 식기세척기에요.  2. 처음에는 깔끔하게 문이 아래로 활짝 열리는 식기세척기를 사고 싶었는데, 싱크대 수전과 부딪혀서 놓을 수 없더라고요. 근데 이 제품은 위 아래 양문형으로 열려서 싱크대 공간이 좁은 곳에서도 문을 활짝 열 수 있어요.  3. 2단 트레이를 자유롭게 넣었다 뺐다 할 수 있어요. 후라이팬이나 냄비처럼 큰 식기를 넣을 때는 2단 트레이를 빼고 1단만으로 이용 가능해요. 2단 트레이에 컵이나 밥그릇, 수저 등 넣고 돌리는 것도 괜찮아요.  4. 자동 문열림 기능이 없어서 고민했는데, 열풍 건조 되고 나서 상단에 김이 빠지는 곳 만으로도 충분하게 바짝 건조가 되더라고요. 이 부분은 고민하는 분들이 많으실텐데, 밤새 돌려두고 아침에 열어보면 그릇에 물기 없이 다 말라 있으니까 걱정 안 하셔도 될 것 같아요. 사용하는 세제에 따라 다르겠지만, 올인원(린스 포함) 세제를 이용하면 유리컵에도 얼룩이 거의 안 남아요. (그릇에 따라 조금씩 물때가 남는 경우는 있지만 대체로는 괜찮은 것 같아요)  5. 깊이가 45cm인데, 하단 발굽이 조금 더 안쪽에 있어서 42~43cm 정도의 공간이 확보되면 설치가 가능해요. 저는 그래도 조금 공간이 부족해서 싱크대 연장판 맞춰서 설치했어요. 6. 열풍 건조 기능이 있어서 그릇이 따끈따끈하게 소독되어 나오고 기분이 좋습니다.  7. 사람이 손으로 하는 것보다 물도 훨씬 적게 쓰고 그릇이 훨씬 깨끗하게 잘 세척이 돼요. ■ 단점  1. 장점이자 단점인데, 생각보다 큽니다. 처음에는 주방이 너무 답답해보여서 살짝 후회했는데, 익숙해지기도 하고, 설겆이 노동량이 80% 정도 줄어드니까 사실 기능적인 만족감이 커서 이 부분은 문제는 아니라고 생각해요.  2. 소음이 조금 있긴 하지만, 백색소음 같은 느낌이긴 해요. 3. 기본 코스로만 돌리는데 생각보다 가동시간이 길어서 저녁 먹고 돌리면 잠들기 전까지 계속 기계가 돌아가요. 생각보다 길게 돌아가다보니 그릇이 몇개 없을 때는 돌릴까 말까 고민이 드네요. 이건 모든 식기세척기 공통 상항일 듯 합니다. 짧은 코스로 돌리는 것도 있는데 아직 사용은 안 해봤어요.  4. 두께가 있는 접시는 꽂아 넣기가 조금 어려워요. 코렐 같은 얇은 접시나 그릇이 확실히 사용하기에 더 적합하긴 해요. ■ 총평  식기세척기 꼭 사세요. 월세집/전세집 공사까지 할 엄두가 안 나서 계속 단념하고 살았는데, 카운터탑만으로도 전보다 삶의 질이 확연히 높아지네요!

(그릇에 따라 조금씩 물때가 남는 경우는 있지만 대체로는 괜찮은 것 같아요)  5. 깊이가 45cm인데, 하단 발굽이 조금 더 안쪽에 있어서 42~43cm 정도의 공간이 확보되면 설치가 가능해요. 저는 그래도 조금 공간이 부족해서 싱크대 연장판 맞춰서 설치했어요. 6. 열풍 건조 기능이 있어서 그릇이 따끈따끈하게 소독되어 나오고 기분이 좋습니다.  7. 사람이 손으로 하는 것보다 물도 훨씬 적게 쓰고 그릇이 훨씬 깨끗하게 잘 세척이 돼요. ■ 단점  1. 장점이자 단점인데, 생각보다 큽니다. 처음에는 주방이 너무 답답해보여서 살짝 후회했는데, 익숙해지기도 하고, 설겆이 노동량이 80% 정도 줄어드니까 사실 기능적인 만족감이 커서 이 부분은 문제는 아니라고 생각해요.  2. 소음이 조금 있긴 하지만, 백색소음 같은 느낌이긴 해요. 3. 기본 코스로만 돌리는데 생각보다 가동시간이 길어서 저녁 먹고 돌리면 잠들기 전까지 계속 기계가 돌아가요. 생각보다 길게 돌아가다보니 그릇이 몇개 없을 때는 돌릴까 말까 고민이 드네요. 이건 모든 식기세척기 공통 상항일 듯 합니다. 짧은 코스로 돌리는 것도 있는데 아직 사용은 안 해봤어요.  4. 두께가 있는 접시는 꽂아 넣기가 조금 어려워요. 코렐 같은 얇은 접시나 그릇이 확실히 사용하기에 더 적합하긴 해요. ■ 총평  식기세척기 꼭 사세요. 월세집/전세집 공사까지 할 엄두가 안 나서 계속 단념하고 살았는데, 카운터탑만으로도 전보다 삶의 질이 확연히 높아지네요!

Comments (English): [ It fits compactly in tight spaces and performs well! ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase: I don't want to waste time washing dishes after work, but I couldn't find a suitable dishwasher because my sink is small. I happened to see it in an offline store and thought I could put it in my house if I did it right, so I bought it. Advantages 1. It's a small but still large dishwasher that can be placed in a house with a small sink. 2. At first, I wanted to buy a dishwasher with a door that opens wide downwards neatly, but it couldn't be placed because it bumped into the sink faucet. However, this product opens up and down, so the door can be opened wide even in a place with a small sink space. 3. You can freely put in and take out the two-tier tray. When putting in large dishes such as frying pans or pots, you can remove the two-tier tray and use only the first tier. It's okay to put cups, rice bowls, spoons, etc. in the two-tier tray and turn it. 4. I was worried because there was no automatic door opening function, but after the hot air dries, the steam escapes from the top, and it dries thoroughly. Many people may be concerned about this part, but if you leave it overnight and open it in the morning, the dishes will be completely dry, so you don't have to worry. It depends on the detergent you use, but if you use an all-in-one detergent (including rinse), there will be almost no stains on the glass cup. (There may be a little water stains depending on the bowl, but it seems okay overall.) 5. It is 45cm deep, but the bottom hoof is a little further inside, so if you secure about 42~43cm of space, you can install it. I was still a little short on space, so I installed it by matching the sink extension. 6. It has a hot air drying function, so the dishes come out warm and sterilized, which feels good. 7. It uses much less water than doing it by hand, and the dishes are washed much more cleanly. Disadvantages 1. It's both an advantage and a disadvantage, but it's bigger than you think. At first, I regretted it a little because the kitchen seemed too stuffy, but I got used to it, and since the amount of work to wash dishes is reduced by about 80%, I actually feel a lot of functional satisfaction, so I don't think this is a problem. 2. It's a little noisy, but it feels like white noise. 3. I only use the basic course, but the operating time is longer than I thought, so the machine keeps running until I go to bed after dinner. Since it runs longer than I thought, I sometimes hesitate whether to run it or not when there aren't many dishes. I think this is common for all dishwashers. There is one that runs on a short course, but I haven't used it yet. 4. It's a little difficult to insert thick plates. Thin plates or bowls like Corelle are definitely more suitable for use. Overall review: You should definitely buy a dishwasher. I kept giving up because I didn't have the courage to do construction on my rented/lease house, but the quality of my life has definitely improved with just the countertop!

Sentence (English): Review after a few months of use.
Comments (English): Review after a few months of use. Just buy it. You absolutely must buy a dishwasher. I'm the kind of person who didn't buy a dishwasher when moving into a new house because I hated bending over, but I didn't know something like this existed. It's easy to operate, and I like that my previous cycles are saved. The performance is good. I usually rinse things with water before putting them in, so I don't know what would happen if I just threw in really dirty stuff. Now for the important part: things first-time buyers might be curious about. 1. Even if you put in half a "Frog" (a type of milk cup) on the 30-minute Quick cycle, the dishes get done. It doesn't run at a high temperature above 70 degrees, but it doesn't use cold water either. 2. However, if you have a lot of greasy food, milk, or empty cups, running it on Quick with High temperature will get them warm and fluffy in about an hour. 3. Important: Fishy smells. The fishy smell from milk or yogurt cups is solved with the Lemon Frog cycle and High temperature mode. 4. It's not loud. I have super sensitive ears, and I'm not worried about noise between floors. In fact, I want to keep listening to the initial water and wind sounds; it's like ASMR. 5. I have many microwave-safe containers, and even after microwaving them at high temperatures, none have deformed yet. Lock & Lock is expensive, so it would be a waste if it deformed, but I gave it a try and it didn't change. 6. It covers about two or three meals a day for two adults. Of course, I don't serve elaborate meals like a true 21st-century MG; I tend to eat simply. I was told it's best not to put frying pans and knives in the microwave, so I hand-washed them. 7. Water stains seem inevitable. Since I have a lot of glass cups, if you don't like seeing water stains, adding fabric softener should solve the problem.

Comments (English): [ Good appliance but customer services is a mess. ] || ---------------- || These are supposedly a very reliable appliance, and you better hope it is, because if it does fail, like mine did, they have some of the worst customer service I have ever dealt with. It was 50 DAYS from calling them for help to finally having a working dishwasher again. I had to call them at least 20 times to finish the process. The entire process was a frustrating waste of time filled with conflicting information and procedures that seemed like they were designed to make you give up and just go buy a new dishwasher.Here are a couple fun facts to help you understand how frustrating it is. 1) The automated phone menu has no option for calling about an existing ticket. The menu has 3 options and it's completely irrelevant which you press. For any of the options, you get sent to someone who has to look up your case number to figure out who to transfer you to. 2) They have no extensions or way to get to the department that handles warranty repairs without calling the general number and being transferred.They apparently have no way to exchange your info to another service rep. So every single time you get transferred, you have to provide your case number and verify your info a second time. After my first call, I had to give my case number and verify my address twice on EVERY SINGLE ONE of 20+ calls.3) Every time the verification is different. Sometimes they read the address for you to confirm. Sometimes they make you say just your street. Sometimes they make you give your full address with zip code. Seems like they have no policy, it's just up to each rep to verify identify however they feel like. 4) In my zip code, they list 4 “Bosch authorized service repair centers”, who you would think you could call to get repairs done on your Bosch appliance. But one said they don't even come to within 30 miles of my zip, and the other 3 will only service appliances they sold. 5) Twice I had to send them a photo of a document (sales receipt, appliance info tag), and they said give them 24 hours to verify. BOTH times, I called back 3 days later and said I didn't send it. Then I told them the exact time I sent it (with the automated confirmation email I received), they put me on hold, and came back to say they “found it”. These are all minor annoyances, but show the company does not put much effort into customer service. Here was the experience I had getting a warranty replacement. The dishwasher stopped cleaning stuff on the bottom rack. It seemed like the bottom arm stopped spinning. I called to ask for technical support and they told me to check for clogs. I asked where and which parts I could check, and after I gave them the model number, they said they don't have details on parts of each different models, so just generally check the spray arm and bottom filter for clogs. The tech support person was not sure if my model had a diverter valve or not, and just said I should call an authorized repair center to come look at it. It was less than a year old and still under full warranty.I called all 4 authorized service repair centers on their website for my zip code, and they all said either I was out of their area or that they only service units they sold. I called Bosh back to see if they could help and they said they can contact the repair centers directly to find one who can assist. [Start of week 2] I call back for an update and they said that they are waiting for a repair center to respond. It turns out they contacted one of the “authorized repair centers” I already called, who declines Bosh as well. I call back again to learn this and ask if they have contacted other places, but they had not - apparently they were just waiting for me to call back. They eventually find someone an hour away who will come and look at my dishwasher.[Start of week 3] Repair person comes and decides the motor/diverter valve assembly should be replaced, but needs to get the part shipped from Bosch. Repair person comes back later in week with part, spends 2 hours installing it, and then says the dishwasher won't start. It just flashes red lights and beeps. He spends an hour on the phone with Bosh and can't figure it out. Eventually he and the Bosch rep on the phone give up and decide to scrap my dishwasher and have me request a replacement unit. Until now I had a dishwasher that would wash the top 2 racks, now I can't use it at all. Apparently a replacement unit can't be approved by anyone you can talk to on the phone, it takes up to 7-10 days for someone at Bosh to review my case, including me having to re-upload documents, while I wait for them to say if they are going to send a replacement unit or not. [Week 4] After 8 days and two more phone calls they finally approve sending a replacement unit. Now they ask for 10 days to find an installer. [Week 5] On day 8 I call for a status update. They had contacted 2 installers (both on the authorized repair center list), and both declined. The rep gives me another option: They ship the unit directly to me, I destroy the old one by drilling a hole in the side, and they give me $450 for my trouble. I say ok, and the rep says I will get an email to confirm and provide all the info necessary. [Week 6] After receiving no emails for 3 days, I call back. They say there is no record of agreeing to let me install the unit myself, and they would not be able to do that. I talk to 3 people and they all refuse the offer I was given. I am only able to get a refund for the on-sale purchase price (not the replacement price) or allow them to continue searching for an installer. I begrudgingly ask them to keep searching. Later in the week they find an installer. Eventually I find out it is the one who did the repair, but they waited until 4 other declines and 14 days to contact them. But at the time, the rep refuses to tell me which installer they found to do the install. Now they tell me the unit is backordered and won't ship out for another month and a half. I ask for reimbursement for renting a portable dishwasher for that time, and they refuse. I call back the next day to talk about other options, and now they say the unit will ship out the next Monday. They also give me the installer name. They seem to have no consistent policy. Two more calls getting conflicting info on when the unit will ship and they tell me it has shipped. [Week 7] Installer calls to say they have the unit and will come at the end of the week to install it. Installer comes and I finally have a working dishwasher again. Nice appliance. Worst customer service experience I have had.

The menu has 3 options and it's completely irrelevant which you press. For any of the options, you get sent to someone who has to look up your case number to figure out who to transfer you to. 2) They have no extensions or way to get to the department that handles warranty repairs without calling the general number and being transferred.They apparently have no way to exchange your info to another service rep. So every single time you get transferred, you have to provide your case number and verify your info a second time. After my first call, I had to give my case number and verify my address twice on EVERY SINGLE ONE of 20+ calls.3) Every time the verification is different. Sometimes they read the address for you to confirm. Sometimes they make you say just your street. Sometimes they make you give your full address with zip code. Seems like they have no policy, it's just up to each rep to verify identify however they feel like. 4) In my zip code, they list 4 “Bosch authorized service repair centers”, who you would think you could call to get repairs done on your Bosch appliance. But one said they don't even come to within 30 miles of my zip, and the other 3 will only service appliances they sold. 5) Twice I had to send them a photo of a document (sales receipt, appliance info tag), and they said give them 24 hours to verify. BOTH times, I called back 3 days later and said I didn't send it. Then I told them the exact time I sent it (with the automated confirmation email I received), they put me on hold, and came back to say they “found it”. These are all minor annoyances, but show the company does not put much effort into customer service. Here was the experience I had getting a warranty replacement. The dishwasher stopped cleaning stuff on the bottom rack. It seemed like the bottom arm stopped spinning. I called to ask for technical support and they told me to check for clogs. I asked where and which parts I could check, and after I gave them the model number, they said they don't have details on parts of each different models, so just generally check the spray arm and bottom filter for clogs. The tech support person was not sure if my model had a diverter valve or not, and just said I should call an authorized repair center to come look at it. It was less than a year old and still under full warranty.I called all 4 authorized service repair centers on their website for my zip code, and they all said either I was out of their area or that they only service units they sold. I called Bosh back to see if they could help and they said they can contact the repair centers directly to find one who can assist. [Start of week 2] I call back for an update and they said that they are waiting for a repair center to respond. It turns out they contacted one of the “authorized repair centers” I already called, who declines Bosh as well. I call back again to learn this and ask if they have contacted other places, but they had not - apparently they were just waiting for me to call back. They eventually find someone an hour away who will come and look at my dishwasher.[Start of week 3] Repair person comes and decides the motor/diverter valve assembly should be replaced, but needs to get the part shipped from Bosch. Repair person comes back later in week with part, spends 2 hours installing it, and then says the dishwasher won't start. It just flashes red lights and beeps. He spends an hour on the phone with Bosh and can't figure it out. Eventually he and the Bosch rep on the phone give up and decide to scrap my dishwasher and have me request a replacement unit. Until now I had a dishwasher that would wash the top 2 racks, now I can't use it at all. Apparently a replacement unit can't be approved by anyone you can talk to on the phone, it takes up to 7-10 days for someone at Bosh to review my case, including me having to re-upload documents, while I wait for them to say if they are going to send a replacement unit or not. [Week 4] After 8 days and two more phone calls they finally approve sending a replacement unit. Now they ask for 10 days to find an installer. [Week 5] On day 8 I call for a status update. They had contacted 2 installers (both on the authorized repair center list), and both declined. The rep gives me another option: They ship the unit directly to me, I destroy the old one by drilling a hole in the side, and they give me $450 for my trouble. I say ok, and the rep says I will get an email to confirm and provide all the info necessary. [Week 6] After receiving no emails for 3 days, I call back. They say there is no record of agreeing to let me install the unit myself, and they would not be able to do that. I talk to 3 people and they all refuse the offer I was given. I am only able to get a refund for the on-sale purchase price (not the replacement price) or allow them to continue searching for an installer. I begrudgingly ask them to keep searching. Later in the week they find an installer. Eventually I find out it is the one who did the repair, but they waited until 4 other declines and 14 days to contact them. But at the time, the rep refuses to tell me which installer they found to do the install. Now they tell me the unit is backordered and won't ship out for another month and a half. I ask for reimbursement for renting a portable dishwasher for that time, and they refuse. I call back the next day to talk about other options, and now they say the unit will ship out the next Monday. They also give me the installer name. They seem to have no consistent policy. Two more calls getting conflicting info on when the unit will ship and they tell me it has shipped. [Week 7] Installer calls to say they have the unit and will come at the end of the week to install it. Installer comes and I finally have a working dishwasher again. Nice appliance. Worst customer service experience I have had.

Sentence (English): Overall, this is a very nice dishwasher, and I'm happy with Lowe's for the purchase.
Comments (English): [ No way to turn off heated drying ] || ---------------- || Overall, this is a very nice dishwasher, and I'm happy with Lowe's for the purchase. The dishwasher cleans extremely well, drys very well, and is quiet (the reviews saying it doesn't dry just aren't true, at least with the one I received). However, there is definitely a heated dry that is used on this dishwasher regardless of all the information that says it doesn't use a heating element to dry. There is NO way to turn off the heated dry for any of the cycles. My dishes (plastics included) get VERY hot after the drying cycle, hotter than I want them to. The unit itself heats up a significant amount during the drying cycle. So if you are like me and want to rely on mostly air drying for your dishes, this may disappoint you because you're going to have to manually stop the dishwasher before the drying cycle every single time you run it. I've complained to Bosch about needing to provide a cycle without heated drying like every dishwasher I've ever had before, and I got no response back from them. I also believe that this is the same case for the Bosch 500 that had the has auto air feature! What's the point if there is no way to turn off the heated dry in the first place? Makes me glad I didn't spend the money for that model.Also, my dishwasher came without an insulated blanket on and I was forced to the use the old dirty one off my old dishwasher. I believe that's one of the reasons why this model says 48 db is because they don't include a blanket on it which will make the dishwasher noisier.

Sentence (English): Everyone I know who owns a Bosch loves them!
Comments (English): [ This machine does not work for my needs ] || ---------------- || Everyone I know who owns a Bosch loves them! I admit I did not do a lot of research and look closely at the inside configuration before purchasing. Shame on me! I am paying the price now! The middle rack has 3 height settings. My water glasses are tall so I need to put this rack on the lowest setting for my tall glasses. When I do that, the height above the bottom rack is not tall enough for my dinner plates! Next issue, all the "vertical" posts are NOT vertical. They are at an angle & many of my bowls slide around on them making it very difficult to maximize my space. Another issue is that the setting controls are on the top of the door. That would be okay, except I am on a time-of-use program with my electric company, & to use this feature, I have to download the Bosch app onto my phone & use it from my phone! The one good comment I have is that it is the quietest dishwasher I have owned in my lifetime! So buyer beware! I am now shopping for another machine and taking my dishware and glasses with me! Do you know anyone who would like to buy a slightly used Bosch for a greatly reduced price!

Sentence (English): I had purchased this dishwasher 12/17/24 so I've had it for about 2 months and I will say it does the basic job of being a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Not an above average dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I had purchased this dishwasher 12/17/24 so I've had it for about 2 months and I will say it does the basic job of being a dishwasher. Great features:-Super quiet, I barely hear it running compared to our old one. - sleek look and really like the look of the timer on the outside. - 3 racks creates a lot of space so perfect for cleaning up large messes. - I've connected it to the smart things app and now I can monitor, start and get notifications on my phone regarding the dishwasher. - adjustable middle rack is AMAZING when you have tall items on the bottom. - I do really like the open drying option for the last 10 minutes to help dry dishes. About 99% come out dry as long as you use rinse aid. Here are the cons:- I don't think it washes my dishes that great, it's pretty average. I do have dishes that aren't clean and I have to wash again. - the racks don't feel of high quality and sway side to side, they feel cheap. - long dish cycles but that's with all new dishwashers - 2 months in and had an issue with the drainage even though filter and drain pump are clean, still working on getting this figured out.For the cost of this dang dishwasher I expected a lot better and went with Samsung due to having other matching appliances but this dishwasher is meh, I'm not blown away but it does the job.

Sentence (English): This product is so close to being good.
Comments (English): [ Quiet but so aggravating to use ] || ---------------- || This product is so close to being good. It's quiet, it cleans well, it looks sharp. But two things hold it back: loading and operation. A key goal of product design is that the product should be simple for the end user. Whoever designed the layout in Bosch dishwashers should be fired. The prongs are angled so steeply that they make it impossible for certain dishes to fit and create a large amount of wasted space. I can fit maybe half of what I used to fit in my whirlpool dishwasher, in the same amount of space. The other pain is that there is no way to cancel a cycle once it has started, and it starts very easily with the brush of a hand. You can pause a cycle, but if say you forgot to select the autodry option, or you wanted a shorter run, or not as hot, too bad! It absolutely has to go through that entire cycle. Hitting reset does nothing but reset that specific wash you've started. At this price point I can't recommend it to anybody when there are so many products with less aggravation.In the photos: I used to fit four black dinner bowls easily, now I have to use this wonky setup to fit two bowls max, when these are our main plates. You can also see how much wasted space exists when the prongs block out all that area against the front of the tray.

I made an appointment with the technician to coordinate the time, but he was so busy that he continued the installation until late at night. Sentence (English): I'm a working mom, and my husband comes home late, so most of the housework was my job.
Comments (English): [ Why did I buy this now? ] || ---------------- || I'm a working mom, and my husband comes home late, so most of the housework was my job. Among them, the chore I hated the most was washing dishes. I used a SK 6-person dishwasher, but it wasn't enough to handle the dishes in our house where we often eat home-cooked meals. When I heard people around me say that installing a dishwasher was good, I asked them and they said that the brand was mostly LG dishwashers. When I first got married, I bought home appliances at a low price, so I didn't have any LG appliances. They say that LG is the best for home appliances~~^^ So this time, I made up my mind and bought LG. It was about 1 million won, so I talked it over with my husband and said, "Let's go." Wow. It was rocket installation, so the technician came the next day after I ordered it. Even though it was a holiday, he came right at the time I wanted and started the installation. However, the height of the sink drawer in my house didn't allow for installation. He also recommended another method of installing it under the gas range, so I decided to do that. It's a little bit far from the sink, but I thought it had to be installed that day, so I told him to install it. A veteran driver adjusted the height as much as possible, and I was very satisfied with the finish. I started using it that day. Needless to say, I was very satisfied with the review. A particularly good point was that it was possible to use large pots and frying pans, which were not possible with a 6-person unit. There is a separate knife holder, and the top part is height-adjustable, so you can easily put in ladles, tongs, etc. After putting in all the dishes, cups, etc. that come out during the day, I finished dinner and ran the dishwasher, and that was the end of the kitchen. It was the best product I bought in my 15 years of marriage. Please buy it quickly! The only thing you have to worry about is your wrists.

The kitchen is narrow. - Because the kitchen is narrow, it was difficult to put 6 people on the sink. - I live alone, so I asked myself a lot about whether I really need more than 12 people, but I couldn't ignore the value of dishwashing time. - Among built-in products, I chose LG, which I trust, for home appliances after comprehensively considering other large companies. - I searched for "LG Objet Dishwasher Model Name Analysis" on a portal site and studied the model names. - As a one-person household, I didn't need hot air drying, True Steam, or storage space up to 3 levels. - After studying, I found that DUBJ1EP was a reasonable choice for me. - I bought it on Coupang for 540,000 won on 1/13 (Sat). - All the home appliances are LG, and it was good because it was an officially certified store that I can trust in terms of installation and after-sales service. - I live in Busan, so I applied for delivery on 1/13 (Sat) and the technician visited on 1/15 (Mon). 2. On the day of installation - One technician came. I took pictures with the technician's permission. He said my face could be shown. - The installation fee was free when installed in the standard cabinet. - I haven't used the oven in the 7 years since I moved into the house, and the only space for the oven was the standard cabinet, so I tried to install it there. - I thought I would separate the oven and the drawer below and remove it, but I didn't know that the entire cabinet would be removed. - I'm storing the standard cabinet and oven separately because I plan to restore them to their original state when I move in the future. - I regret not having installed the dishwasher earlier if I had known this would happen. - Next, I leveled the dishwasher and connected the water pipe under the sink. - They told me to contact them if there was a leak in the water pipe in the future, but that hasn't happened for 3 weeks. - They gave me a simple explanation and instructions on how to use it. - The LG technician was very kind. 3. 3 weeks after installation - As soon as I installed it, I put 1kg of salt that I had purchased in advance and the correct amount of water into the water softener and stirred it with wooden chopsticks. - I sterilized the tank with vinegar before the first use. - I've used it 5 times so far, and although I used frog detergent, there were still some water stains from tap water. - I recommend using rinse if possible. The water stains have definitely been reduced when I used rinse. - The standard course is a 55-minute course, but the door opens automatically a few minutes before the end, and it dries well enough even without the hot air dryer. - It seems to clean well enough even without the True Steam function. - There is enough storage for spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, but if I buy it again, I think I'll buy a 3-tier model that has a 100,000 won difference so that I can put spoons and chopsticks on the top shelf. - It seems to be a reasonable model with all the basic functions, although it is not a recent model with hot air drying, true steam, and a two-tier shelf. - If you are not in a hurry, put it in your cart and buy it when the price drops. - I bought it for around 540,000 won with Coupang's own discount and card discount. - I regret buying it late because I don't know why it is called the 3rd generation aunt. I will use it well. Thank you^^

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher on 3 March 2021 and in that time it has had technician's out twice for the same fault.
Comments (English): [ Four break downs in under four years.  ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher on 3 March 2021 and in that time it has had technician's out twice for the same fault. The hinges that allow the lower basket to lift are plastic and tend to loosen resulting in water leaking through the hinge holes into the side wall of the washer. The tech who came out the second time, just 2 months after the first repair stated that as the screws are plastic many techs are loathed to tighten them in fear of snapping the screws. He tightened them properly and it hasn't leaked since. The lift does however constantly get jammed and it is more good luck than good management in getting it moving freely again to lower it (usually by putting sideways pressure on the hinge mechanism, but that doesn't always work).Of more concern however, is the heater and thermostat burning out which happened to us in early December 2023, of course it was out of the warranty period by now so I replaced them myself (I am a former technician myself). The parts were rather expensive but the fix worked. until today (11 Feb 25) where the same fault has re-occurred. I'm not bothered to pour good money after bad buying replacement heater and thermostat again so this pile of junk is heading for the tip. When it is working it does a reasonable job of cleaning the dishes but there are some annoyances that go with it, for example;1. The poor handle designs mean they fill with water and don't drain properly so water drips from the underside of the handles constantly so you will get wet hands every time you open a draw, and2. The blue material used to hold items like cups and glasses disintegrates over time so blue pieces of rubber stick to the edges of cups, glasses, bowls etc.Think carefully before you shell out around $2000 for this washer as the added cost over other reputable brands is simply not worth it. My advice, for what it's worth, is to stay away from Electrolux dishwashers.

Sentence (English): Functions as expected, once we could figure out how the controls work.
Comments (English): Functions as expected, once we could figure out how the controls work. It is not very intuitive and acts broken right after installation, but the folks at Bosch are ready for these calls and walked us through everything. You think Bosch would take a hint at the fact that the people they have hired to handle these calls get them all day long. So brace yourself, you'll feel as dumb as a box of rocks when you try to operate this machine. Forget about the manual - all you get there is a diagram that tells you nothing about how to run it, just go ahead and call them. The one BIG disappointment with this appliance is that there is NO indicator for when the cycle is complete and the dishes are clean. So be ready to come up with a system for the family to use to indicate clean dishes. This is baffling to me especially when there is a red light to indicate when the cycle is running. why no green light to show the cycle is complete? The detergent dispenser opens after the cycle is complete. I've read that some folks will put the detergent in as soon as the machine is unloaded then use the dispenser being open as a way to tell if the load is clean or not. The lack of an indicator for clean dishes is crazy to me. I consider that a BASIC function of a dishwasher that isn't from 1972. You can do better Bosch. much better.

Sentence (English): We recently purchased a Bosch Benchmark series dishwasher for our summer home and were so pleased with it that we decided to go with the 800 series (one step below on price and features) for our winter home.
Comments (English): [ Very solid choice - recommended ] || ---------------- || We recently purchased a Bosch Benchmark series dishwasher for our summer home and were so pleased with it that we decided to go with the 800 series (one step below on price and features) for our winter home. Overall, we are very pleased with it with a couple of minor exceptions. First, even though it has the same Crystal Dry technology as the Benchmark, this machine does not dry plastics nearly as well. That could be to do with the difference in water - this water is naturally soft, whereas we have hard water and are using softener salt in the Benchmark. The other main difference is the rack system. Since they are both current generation machines, I assumed that the racks would be nearly the same. This is not the case. The top racks are identical, bottom and middle are much different and took some getting used to. This is not a deal breaker, and definitely not worth paying several hundred dollars more for an upgrade, but it is something that Bosch could improve on future iterations of this machine. Overall, we are pleased with the cleaning and especially with how quiet both machines are. You barely know that they are running. A red beam on the floor below the door is the only indication that the 800 is operating. Our cat, by the way, noticed the beam immediately.
